info.name: Matomo Reporting API for plugin Annotations API

(Required) The site ID to add the annotation to.
(Required) The ID of the note.
The date the annotation is attached to. If null, the annotation's date is not modified.
The text of the annotation (max 255 chars). If null, the annotation's text is not modified.
Whether the annotation should be starred. If null, the annotation is not starred/un-starred, so the current state won't change.
